app.title: Oracle Eight
app.productionTopology: One ASP.NET Core image serves the built React frontend and API.

gates.baseline: Passed: retained branch selected and open issues classified in local-kubernetes-baseline.json.
gates.offlineWorker: Passed: final digest built image.tar.gz (OCI archive) and package.tgz with docker --network none, nonroot, read-only root/source and writable scratch/artifacts.
gates.localDeployment: Passed: real build and deploy Jobs, app-scoped Helm release, restricted pod admission, frontend and answer API ready.
gates.nativeCasting: Passed: browser proposed, explicitly confirmed, and activated a real Squad using the native harness.
gates.firstWave: Passed: frontend specialist changed one paragraph; tester reviewed; isolated validation passed; browser Update online displayed the new paragraph in the sandboxed iframe.
gates.secondWave: Passed: backend specialist changed one API response; tester reviewed; isolated validation passed; live browser answer request returned edition=second-wave.
gates.restartRecovery: Passed for build-stage interruption: coordinator replaced while a build Job ran; same durable run resumed through browser Update online and completed the same release.

waves.observableResult: Introductory paragraph ends with One question, one answer.
GET /api/answer retains a nonempty answer and adds edition=second-wave.

recovery.interruption: kubectl rollout restart deployment/app-deployment in default
recovery.wavesAfterRestart: Both Completed with Passed validation and original commit SHAs.
recovery.earlierFailedAttempts: Retained in the deployment history; not erased or relabeled as successes.

checks: sh -n for worker entrypoints and fixture validation
Real Chrome browser: native casting, two waves, iframe update, answer-button/API interaction; no application page errors.
Coordinator Ready/idle, generated API pod Ready with zero restarts at handoff.
limits: Local fixed-fixture proof only; no AKS replay or Azure resource changes.
Dedicated unauthenticated local registry; production registry authentication is not implemented by this worker.
Docker Desktop kindnet NetworkPolicy enforcement is not verified; offline Docker execution is a different guarantee.
Recovery was interrupted during Building, not during an in-flight Helm transaction or a node failure.
Linux AppHost restore unlocks OS-specific implicit Aspire packages; top-level dependency versions remain pinned.
No arbitrary generated architectures, provider migration, or per-user publication authorization.
Point-in-time functional acceptance, not a long-duration soak or hostile-code security certification.
